youtube.title: Why Is a Brown Drink in a Red Can? 🥫 #Shorts #science #facts #didyouknow
youtube.description:
A brown drink in a red can: how strange is that? It started in Atlanta in 1886 when pharmacist John Pemberton sold a syrup for five cents a glass. His bookkeeper, Frank Robinson, named it and painted the first signs in red letters on white because he liked how it popped. Red stopped being decoration and became the signal. Full episode on the channel.
